statement: Let a cell (i,j) be land when grid[i][j] = 1. Let an island be a maximal nonempty set of land cells that is 4-connected, where two cells are 4-adjacent when their row indices differ by 1 and their column indices are equal, or their column indices differ by 1 and their row indices are equal. Let I be the set of all islands. For two islands S and T, write S ~ T when there exist integers a,b and one of the eight maps f(x,y) = (x,y), (-y,x), (-x,-y), (y,-x), (-x,y), (x,-y), (y,x), (-y,-x) such that T = {(a + u, b + v) : (u,v) = f(i,j) for some (i,j) in S}. The function returns a result r and r is the number of equivalence classes of I under ~.
preconditions: Let m = len(grid). There is an integer n such that 1 <= m <= 50, 1 <= n <= 50, len(grid[i]) = n for every 0 <= i < m, and grid[i][j] is either 0 or 1 for every 0 <= i < m and 0 <= j < n. Cells outside the grid are treated as water.

statement: If m = 1, then the function returns r equal to the number of distinct positive integers L for which the single row grid[0] has a maximal contiguous block of exactly L entries equal to 1. A maximal contiguous block is an interval [a,b] of column indices with 0 <= a <= b < n such that grid[0][c] = 1 for every a <= c <= b, and (a = 0 or grid[0][a-1] = 0) and (b = n-1 or grid[0][b+1] = 0).

statement: Define an island as a maximal nonempty 4-connected component of cells with grid[i][j] = 1. Define two islands S and T to be equivalent when one can be carried to the other by a translation followed by one of the eight symmetries of the square (the four rotations by 0, 90, 180, 270 degrees and the four reflections in the horizontal, vertical, main-diagonal, and anti-diagonal axes). If the set of islands is nonempty and any two islands in it are equivalent, then the function returns r = 1.
